Name: Socoh in the Hill Country
ModernLocation: Khirbet Shuweikah, in the hill country of Judah
Description: A town in Judah's hill country named in Joshua's allotment, distinct from the Socoh of the Elah Valley and the Socoh of Solomon's districts.
BiblicalSignificance: Socoh in the Hill Country is the hill-country namesake of the better-known Elah Valley town.
